events.title: Lachlan Neville and the Lakers w/ Sharptail
events.description:
19+ w/ Valid ID

Lachlan Neville is a singer/songwriter from Rocanville, Saskatchewan- a small town on the plains of western Canada known for potash mining, agriculture and hockey. Exposed at an early age to country and folk music, Lachlan began to write rapidly, honing his lyrical chops and melodic instincts. Inspired by the likes of Dylan, Springsteen and Clark he is bold and intentional in his earthy tales of lives, loss, empathy and mischief.

Sharptail – Blending old-time and Celtic styles with their Saskatchewan roots, Aryn Murray and Mitch Dureault captivate their audience by delivering original’s telling powerful stories & high-energy tunes that reflect their passion for the music they create.

events.title: P. Burns & the Unrelenting Fear w/ Dump Babes
events.description:
19+ w/ Valid ID

A new project from Piper Burns, longtime music and worrying enthusiast. Unrelenting Fear is a fresh batch of Piper’s prehistoric caveman rock music covering such topics as : Meat, Gravy, Work, Online Shopping, Being Annoyed, Being Annoying, Eating Dog Food, Shipwrecks, long lost friends and the Unrelenting Fear that comes with each new day. For those who recall Piper’s old band, The Steves, these new songs will have a familiar place in your auditory experience as well as some familiar faces for the live band! Featuring longtime friends and collaborators, Chris Sleightholm (Snake River) Neil Lutz (Black Thunder) Andy Beisel (Wolf Willow) and Pearl Bogdan (The Steves). This show will be celebrating the release of a tape cassette, featuring the previously mentioned music.

Formed in 2019 on the foundations of garbage, glitter, and friendship, Dump Babes deliver irresistibly danceable and surprisingly heavy psych-pop tunes. Hailing from Treaty 6 Territory (Saskatoon, SK), the intensely charismatic Aurora Wolfe and her well-rehearsed dirtbag pals serve sex appeal for the entire family.

LISTEN: https://dumpbabes.bandcamp.com/

events.title: Patti and the Stack
events.description:
19+ w/ Valid ID

Patti & the Stack is a five-piece band based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, formed in 2022 and fronted by veteran singer-songwriter Patti Fedrau. Blending international recording experience with deep roots in the local Saskatchewan music scene, the group performs an eclectic mix of original songs and covers spanning rock, blues, urban folk, Motown, country, and pop.

events.title: Winterruption 2027: Chad VanGaalen, Betty Pewapsconias, Christo Graham
events.description:
19+ w/ valid ID

Chad VanGaalen is one of Canada’s most celebrated musicians and visual artists. In addition to being a Juno and Polaris Prize nominated musician, Chad is also an illustrator and animator who has shown across Canada and in Europe. Chad lives in a rickety house in Calgary and doesn’t like to leave home more than he absolutely has to.

Betty Pewapsconias (She/They) is a nēhiyaw artist from Little Pine First Nation. As a digital artist, graphic designer, actor, storyteller, and proud aunty, Betty utilizes the arts as a form of self-expression and advocacy. Through their work, they translate the experience of being a nēhiyaw iskwew with deep ties to kin, community, and responsibility to the land.

Besides being an actor and graphic designer Christo Graham is one of those heart and soul singer/songwriters. You can’t imagine a day when there’s not a tune or lyrical snippet going around in his head

events.title: Winterruption 2027: Cola, Gizmo, Lucy’s Seduction
events.description:
19+ w/ valid ID

Presented by Ness Creek Music Festival.

C.O.L.A. is sort of a self-titled album. It’s an acronym for Cost of Living Adjustment, a fitting conceptual framework for the band’s third record. Why? Because C.O.L.A. considers, among other things, socialism vs. hell. It considers: rolling the dice of life. The eerie and sweet pangs that nostalgia can provoke. Cola, as a band, is defined by its “tasteful minimalism.” A deep appreciation for making music that is romantic, subtle, and deceptively intense.

Gizmo are Charlottetown rockers inspired by the guitar-damaged pop of 1990s American slacker bands and their contemporaries on Canada’s East Coast. A 120 Minutes band for the Gen Z set, they breathe new life into their vintage influences with a distinctive songwriting style and a frenetic live show.

Formed in Saskatoon SK in July 2022 doing some Girlschool covers at local watering hole Black Cat Tavern, Lucy’s Seduction are some solid rock’n roll toilet action come to life and ready to spray their brown riffage all over unsuspecting audiences. Imagine L7, Hole and Motorhead spitting glass and crashing through storefront windows, chased by sirens. Consisting of Brianne Jonsson (guitar/vocals), Cassandra Lavoie (bass/vocals), Shelby Gaudet (guitar/vocals) and James McKnight (drums), Lucy’s are here for the good times, and all creeps and bummers can take a hike.

events.title: Winterruption 2027: Blind Commentary, Dead Ex Girlfriends
events.description:
19+ w/ valid ID

Presented by Ness Creek Music Festival.

‘blind commentary’ is an emerging prairie emo band from saskatoon, saskatchewan, canada. combining the emotional core of midwest emo with the expansive textures of shoegaze, emogaze, and grungegaze, the band has carved out a sound they simply call prairie emo.

dead ex girlfriends are an Indigenous grunge punk band from Treaty 6 Territory (Saskatoon, SK), and they are not here to be quiet. Formed in 2020, this 4-piece – Vada Boyer (they/she), Gabrielle Giroux (she/her), Siena Rose (she/her), and Cairo Dawn (she/her) – blend riot grrrl urgency, grunge grit, and raw emotional storytelling into blistering live shows that feel like both a confrontation and a party.

events.title: Winterruption 2027 Close Out Party: Blue Hawaii, Bloodwork
events.description:
19+ w/ valid ID

Presented by Ness Creek Music Festival.

A duo skilled at turning heartache and separation into danceable electronic alt-pop, Blue Hawaii is Raphaelle Standell and Alexander Kirby Cowan. Their sound waivers between an underground, emotional introspection and club ready hyperpop. They are based in Montreal and Berlin and combine those influences as a blend of European dance music with R&B/pop vocals to create a distinctly carefree sound, especially energetic and fun live, resonating with queer communities everywhere.

Bloodwork is a Saskatoon-based producer who’s crate-digging has led to the perfect blend of rainy day hip-hop beats and dark, cinematic pop. Pulling samples from sources like J-Pop, French garage rock, grandma’s old gospel recordings, and lost TV shows, Bloodwork’s debut album, I Went Back in Time to Save You, creates an unforgettable soundscape akin to DJ Shadow, Madlib, El-P. and The Avalanches.
